integrity: Proof relies on martingale FCLT plus verified predictable variation and Karamata tail; 320 exact finite checks supplement but do not establish functional convergence.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic reversal probabilities tending to zero; terminal limit is used for centering; convergence only on compact positive time intervals; no quantitative error rates or independent validation. A 2021 related dependent-Bernoulli Gaussian-fluctuation article was not available in full text and represents a residual priority risk.
title: Stable inverse-time Gaussian field for a cooling two-colour urn
